<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sp_widget"><sp_widget action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><category>custom</category><client_script><![CDATA[api.controller = function($scope, $window, spUtil) {
    var c = this;

    // Default State Initialization
    c.data.currentStep    = 1;
    c.data.isSubmitting   = false;
    c.data.isFetching     = false;
    c.data.panSearchText  = '';
    c.data.panSuggestions = [];
    c.data.allSites       = [];
    c.showDoneeDropdown   = false; 

    c.selected = {
        pan: '',
        doneeSite: '',
        doneeSiteDisplayCode: '',
        doneeSiteDisplayName: '',
        doneeSiteName: '', // HIGHLIGHT: SET VALUE
        doneeAmount: null,
        donorSite: '',
        donorSiteName: '',
        donorAvailable: null,
        comments: ''
    };
    
    // Check access on load
    c.server.update().then(function() {
        c.data.isInitialized = true;
    });

    // --- Window Click Listener to Close Custom Dropdown ---
    $window.onclick = function(event) {
        if (!event.target.closest('.abg-custom-select')) {
            c.showDoneeDropdown = false;
            $scope.$applyAsync();
        }
    };

    // --- Typeahead PAN & Name Search ---
    c.handlePanInput = function() {
        // HIGHLIGHT: SET VALUE - Clear out values when changing PAN
        c.selected.pan = ''; 
        c.data.allSites = [];
        c.clearDonor();

        var query = c.data.panSearchText ? c.data.panSearchText.toUpperCase() : '';
        if (query.length >= 3) {
            c.data.action = 'fetch_pan_suggestions';
            c.data.isFetching = true;
            c.server.update().then(function() { 
                c.data.action = ''; 
                c.data.isFetching = false;
            });
        } else {
            c.data.panSuggestions = [];
        }
    };

    c.selectPan = function(selectedPan) {
        // HIGHLIGHT: SET VALUE - Assigned selected PAN
        c.selected.pan = selectedPan;
        c.data.panSearchText = selectedPan;
        c.data.panSuggestions = [];

        c.data.action = 'fetch_all_sites';
        c.data.isFetching = true;
        c.server.update().then(function() {
            c.data.action = '';
            c.data.isFetching = false;
        });
    };

    // --- Custom Dropdown Selection Logic ---
    c.toggleDoneeDropdown = function(event) {
        if (event) event.stopPropagation();
        c.showDoneeDropdown = !c.showDoneeDropdown;
    };

    c.selectDonee = function(site) {
        // HIGHLIGHT: SET VALUE - Bind donee UI variables with the selected site's values
        c.selected.doneeSite = site.sys_id;
        c.selected.doneeSiteDisplayCode = site.customer_code;
        c.selected.doneeSiteDisplayName = site.name;
        c.selected.doneeSiteName = site.customer_code + ' — ' + site.name; 
        
        c.showDoneeDropdown = false;
        c.onDoneeChange();
    };

    c.onDoneeChange = function() {
        c.clearDonor();
    };

    c.clearDonor = function() {
        // HIGHLIGHT: SET VALUE - Resetting donor variables
        c.selected.donorSite = '';
        c.selected.donorSiteName = '';
        c.selected.donorAvailable = null;
    };

    c.getDonorSites = function() {
        if (!c.data.allSites) return [];
        return c.data.allSites.filter(function(site) {
            return site.sys_id !== c.selected.doneeSite;
        });
    };

    // Alert if donors are valid but locked in ongoing request
    c.hasOnlyInsufficientSites = function() {
        var donors = c.getDonorSites();
        if (donors.length === 0) return false;
        return donors.every(function(site) {
            return site.available < c.selected.doneeAmount || site.has_ongoing_request;
        });
    };

    c.selectDonor = function(site) {
        if (site.available < c.selected.doneeAmount || site.has_ongoing_request) return;
        
        // HIGHLIGHT: SET VALUE - Mapping Donor variables for Submit Payload
        c.selected.donorSite = site.sys_id;
        c.selected.donorSiteName = site.customer_code + ' — ' + site.name;
        c.selected.donorAvailable = site.available;
    };

    // --- Validation & Navigation ---
    c.isStep1Valid = function() {
        return c.selected.pan && 
            c.selected.doneeSite && 
            c.selected.doneeAmount > 0 && 
            c.selected.donorSite;
    };

    c.goToReview = function() {
        c.data.currentStep = 2;
    };

    c.goToDashboard = function() {
        $window.location.href = '?id=uclm_limit_swap'; 
    };

    // --- Submit Application ---
    c.submitSwap = function() {
        c.data.isSubmitting = true;
        c.data.action = 'submitSwap';
        
        // HIGHLIGHT: BINDING - Send complete selected object payload to the server
        c.data.payload = c.selected; 

        c.server.update().then(function() {
            c.data.isSubmitting = false;
            c.data.action = '';

            if (c.data.serverError) {
                spUtil.addErrorMessage(c.data.serverError);
                c.data.currentStep = 2;
                return;
            }
            c.data.currentStep = 3; 
        });
    };

    c.resetForm = function() {
        c.data.currentStep    = 1;
        c.data.swapNumber     = null;
        c.data.panSearchText  = '';
        c.data.panSuggestions = [];
        c.data.allSites       = [];
        c.showDoneeDropdown   = false;

        c.selected = {
            pan: '', doneeSite: '', doneeSiteDisplayCode: '', doneeSiteDisplayName: '', doneeSiteName: '', doneeAmount: null,
            donorSite: '', donorSiteName: '', donorAvailable: null, comments: ''
        };
    };
};]]></client_script><controller_as>c</controller_as><css>/* Global Variables */

.success-icon { font-size: 64px; color: #2E7D32; line-height: 1; }</css><data_table>sp_instance</data_table><demo_data/><description/><docs/><field_list/><has_preview>true</has_preview><id/><internal>false</internal><link><![CDATA[function link(scope, element, attrs, controller) {  }]]></link><name>UCLM Limit Swap Request</name><option_schema/><public>false</public><roles/><script><![CDATA[(function() {
    // ==========================================
    // 1. INITIALIZATION & CONSTANTS
    // ==========================================
    var userId = gs.getUserID();
    var SEGMENT_MAPPING = { 'UTCL': 'Cement', 'URMX': 'RMC', 'GIL': 'BPD' };

    // ==========================================
    // 2. REUSABLE HELPER FUNCTIONS
    // ==========================================

    /**
     * Fetches all jurisdictional permissions for the logged-in user.
     * Groups them into an array of strict matching rules.
     * ONLY allows users with 'TSH' or 'TSM' in their matrix role.
     */
    function getUserPermissions(targetUserId) {
        var permissions = [];
        var mxGr = new GlideRecord('x_birl3_clm_approval_matrix');
        mxGr.addQuery('approver_user', targetUserId);
        mxGr.addQuery('customer_type', 'non_trade');
        mxGr.query();
        
        while (mxGr.next()) {
            var roleName = (mxGr.getValue('role_name') || '').toUpperCase();
            
            // SECURITY CHECK: Role must contain TSH or TSM
            if (roleName.indexOf('TSH') > -1 || roleName.indexOf('TSM') > -1) {
                permissions.push({
                    segment: mxGr.getValue('segment') || '',
                    zone: mxGr.getValue('zone') || '',
                    region: mxGr.getValue('region') || '',
                    depot: mxGr.getValue('depot') || ''
                });
            }
        }
        return permissions;
    }

    /**
     * Strict evaluation if a site falls under any of the user's specific Matrix combinations.
     * 100% Case-Insensitive matching.
     */
    function isUserAuthorizedForSite(siteSeg, siteZone, siteReg, siteDepot, userPerms) {
        var sSeg = (siteSeg || '').toUpperCase();
        var sZone = (siteZone || '').toUpperCase();
        var sReg = (siteReg || '').toUpperCase();
        var sDepot = (siteDepot || '').toUpperCase();

        for (var i = 0; i < userPerms.length; i++) {
            var p = userPerms[i];
            
            var pSeg = (p.segment || '').toUpperCase();
            var pZone = (p.zone || '').toUpperCase();
            var pReg = (p.region || '').toUpperCase();
            var pDepot = (p.depot || '').toUpperCase();

            // 1. Segment must match
            if (pSeg && pSeg !== sSeg) continue;
            // 2. If Matrix specifies a Zone, the site MUST match it
            if (pZone && pZone !== sZone) continue;
            // 3. If Matrix specifies a Region, the site MUST match it
            if (pReg && pReg !== sReg) continue;
            // 4. If Matrix specifies a Depot, the site MUST match it
            if (pDepot && pDepot !== sDepot) continue;
            
            // If the loop hasn't 'continued', it means the site matches this permission rule perfectly
            return true;
        }
        return false;
    }

    /**
     * Evaluates if a site is currently locked in ANY pending transaction.
     * Checks both Limit Swaps and standard CLR requests.
     */
    function hasOngoingRequest(siteSysId, customerCode) {
        // Check 1: Is it involved in a Pending Limit Swap?
        var swap = new GlideRecord('x_birl3_clm_nt_limit_swap_request');
        var qc = swap.addQuery('donee_site_code', siteSysId);
        qc.addOrCondition('donor_site_code', siteSysId);
        swap.addQuery('approval', '!=', 'approved');
        swap.addQuery('approval', '!=', 'rejected'); 
        swap.setLimit(1);
        swap.query();
        if (swap.hasNext()) return true;

        // Check 2: Is it involved in a Pending Standard Limit Enhancement?
        var clr = new GlideRecord('x_birl3_clm_non_trade_clr');
        clr.addQuery('customer_code', customerCode);
        clr.addQuery('approval', '!=', 'Approved');
        clr.addQuery('approval', '!=', 'Rejected');
        clr.addQuery('approval', '!=', 'Cancelled');
        clr.setLimit(1);
        clr.query();
        if (clr.hasNext()) return true;

        return false;
    }

    /**
     * Safely calculates live outstanding balance for a given customer code.
     */
    function getLiveOutstanding(customerCode) {
        var outRec = new GlideRecord('x_birl3_clm_customer_outstanding');
        outRec.addQuery('customer', customerCode); 
        outRec.orderByDesc('created_on'); 
        outRec.setLimit(1);
        outRec.query();
        if (outRec.next()) {
            return parseFloat(outRec.getValue('outstanding') || 0);
        }
        return 0;
    }

    /**
     * Determines the swap type (A, B, C, D, E) logic based on matrix rules.
     */
    function calculateSwapType(donee, donor) {
        if (donee.segment !== donor.segment) return 'E'; // Diff Segment
        if (donee.depot === donor.depot) return 'A';     // Same depot
        if (donee.region === donor.region) return 'B';   // Same region, diff depot
        if (donee.zone === donor.zone) return 'C';       // Same zone, diff region, diff depot
        return 'D';                                      // Diff Zone (Segment Head required)
    }
    
    /**
     * HIGHLIGHT: GET VALUE - Reusable formatter to combine Name and Code fields
     */
    function getFormattedGeo(gr, nameField, codeField) {
        var name = gr.getValue(nameField) || '';
        var code = gr.getValue(codeField) || '';
        
        if (name && code) {
            return name + ' (' + code + ')';
        } else if (name) {
            return name;
        } else if (code) {
            return code;
        }
        return 'N/A';
    }

    // ==========================================
    // 3. MAIN SCRIPT EXECUTION
    // ==========================================

    var userPermissions = getUserPermissions(userId);

    // --- 0. Access Validation Check on Load ---
    if (!input) {
        data.isTSH = userPermissions.length > 0;
        return; 
    }

    // --- 1. Typeahead PAN / Name Search ---
    if (input.action === 'fetch_pan_suggestions') {
        var searchString = input.panSearchText ? input.panSearchText.toUpperCase() : '';
        data.panSuggestions = [];

        var ga = new GlideRecord('x_birl3_clm_customer');
        ga.addEncodedQuery('panSTARTSWITH' + searchString + '^ORnameLIKE' + searchString);
        ga.orderBy('pan');
        ga.setLimit(15);
        ga.query();

        var addedPans = {};
        while (ga.next()) {
            var panVal = ga.getValue('pan');
            var nameVal = ga.getValue('name');
            if (panVal && !addedPans[panVal]) {
                data.panSuggestions.push({ pan: panVal, name: nameVal });
                addedPans[panVal] = true;
            }
        }
        return;
    }

    // --- 2. Fetch All Sites for PAN (With Jurisdiction & Ongoing Checks) ---
    if (input.action === 'fetch_all_sites') {
        data.allSites = [];
        var gr = new GlideRecord('x_birl3_clm_customer');
        gr.addQuery('pan', input.panSearchText);
        gr.orderBy('customer_code');
        gr.query();

        while (gr.next()) {
            var siteSysId = gr.getUniqueValue();
            var custCode  = gr.getValue('customer_code') || '';
            var compCode  = gr.getValue('company_code') || '';
            
            var siteSeg  = SEGMENT_MAPPING[compCode] || compCode || 'N/A';
            
            // HIGHLIGHT: GET VALUE - Dynamically constructing the format Name(Code) utilizing both Name and Code fields
            var siteZoneFormatted = getFormattedGeo(gr, 'zone_name', 'customer_group');
            var siteRegFormatted  = getFormattedGeo(gr, 'region_name', 'cg4');
            var siteDepFormatted  = getFormattedGeo(gr, 'depot_name', 'sales_office');

            // Internal evaluation variables (keeping raw code values to check jurisdiction permissions accurately)
            var siteZoneRaw = gr.getValue('customer_group') || '';
            var siteRegRaw  = gr.getValue('cg4') || '';
            var siteDepRaw  = gr.getValue('sales_office') || '';

            // Utilize Helpers: Evaluate Jurisdiction & Ongoing Status
            var isAllowed = isUserAuthorizedForSite(siteSeg, siteZoneRaw, siteRegRaw, siteDepRaw, userPermissions);
            var isOngoing = hasOngoingRequest(siteSysId, custCode);

            // Utilize Helper: Calculate limits
            var limit = parseFloat(gr.getValue('credit_limit') || 0);
            var outstanding = getLiveOutstanding(custCode);

            data.allSites.push({
                sys_id:              siteSysId,
                customer_code:       custCode,
                name:                gr.getValue('name'),
                
                // HIGHLIGHT: SET VALUE - Binding Geography combined Name(Code) string to front-end
                zone:                siteZoneFormatted,
                region:              siteRegFormatted,
                depot:               siteDepFormatted,
                
                segment:             siteSeg, 
                credit_limit:        limit,
                outstanding:         outstanding,
                available:           limit - outstanding,
                is_allowed_donee:    isAllowed,
                has_ongoing_request: isOngoing 
            });
        }
        return;
    }

    // --- 3. Submit Swap Application ---
    if (input.action === 'submitSwap') {
        var p = input.payload;

        var donorRec = new GlideRecord('x_birl3_clm_customer');
        var doneeRec = new GlideRecord('x_birl3_clm_customer');

        if (!donorRec.get(p.donorSite)) {
            data.serverError = 'Unable to locate donor site record.';
            return;
        }
        if (!doneeRec.get(p.doneeSite)) {
            data.serverError = 'Unable to locate donee site record.';
            return;
        }

        // --- Package Donor Object ---
        var donorCompCode = donorRec.getValue('company_code') || '';
        var donorObj = {
            code:    donorRec.getValue('customer_code') || '',
            limit:   parseFloat(donorRec.getValue('credit_limit') || 0),
            segment: SEGMENT_MAPPING[donorCompCode] || donorCompCode,
            zone:    donorRec.getValue('customer_group') || '',
            region:  donorRec.getValue('cg4') || '',
            depot:   donorRec.getValue('sales_office') || ''
        };
        donorObj.outstanding = getLiveOutstanding(donorObj.code);
        donorObj.available   = donorObj.limit - donorObj.outstanding;

        if (donorObj.available < parseFloat(p.doneeAmount)) {
            data.serverError = 'Donor site no longer has sufficient available limit. Please refresh and try again.';
            return;
        }

        // --- Package Donee Object ---
        var doneeCompCode = doneeRec.getValue('company_code') || '';
        var doneeObj = {
            code:    doneeRec.getValue('customer_code') || '',
            limit:   parseFloat(doneeRec.getValue('credit_limit') || 0),
            segment: SEGMENT_MAPPING[doneeCompCode] || doneeCompCode,
            zone:    doneeRec.getValue('customer_group') || '',
            region:  doneeRec.getValue('cg4') || '',
            depot:   doneeRec.getValue('sales_office') || ''
        };
        doneeObj.outstanding = getLiveOutstanding(doneeObj.code);
        doneeObj.available   = doneeObj.limit - doneeObj.outstanding;

        // --- Double Check Backend Security (Concurrency & Jurisdiction) ---
        // HIGHLIGHT: The Backend enforces security regardless of UI visibility. Standard users cannot force a submit.
        if (hasOngoingRequest(p.doneeSite, doneeObj.code) || hasOngoingRequest(p.donorSite, donorObj.code)) {
            data.serverError = 'Validation Error: One of the selected sites is currently locked in an ongoing request. Please complete the pending request first.';
            return;
        }

        var isAuthorized = isUserAuthorizedForSite(doneeObj.segment, doneeObj.zone, doneeObj.region, doneeObj.depot, userPermissions);
        if (!isAuthorized) {
            data.serverError = 'Security Violation: You do not have jurisdiction to raise a request for this Donee Site based on your Approval Matrix mapping.';
            return;
        }

        // --- Utilize Helper: Calculate Swap Logic (A, B, C, D, E) ---
        var swapType = calculateSwapType(doneeObj, donorObj);

        // --- Final Insert into New Table ---
        var swap = new GlideRecord('x_birl3_clm_nt_limit_swap_request');
        swap.initialize();

        // HIGHLIGHT: SET VALUE - 1. Binding and Setting Donee Details
        swap.setValue('donee_site_code', p.doneeSite); 
        swap.setValue('donee_segment', doneeObj.segment);
        swap.setValue('donee_current_limit', doneeObj.limit);
        swap.setValue('donee_outstanding', doneeObj.outstanding);
        swap.setValue('donee_available_limit', doneeObj.available);

        // HIGHLIGHT: SET VALUE - 2. Binding and Setting Donor Details
        swap.setValue('donor_site_code', p.donorSite); 
        swap.setValue('donor_segment', donorObj.segment);
        swap.setValue('donor_current_limit', donorObj.limit);
        swap.setValue('donor_outstanding', donorObj.outstanding);
        swap.setValue('donor_available_limit', donorObj.available);

        // HIGHLIGHT: SET VALUE - 3. Transaction Core Details Mapping
        swap.setValue('requested_amount', p.doneeAmount);
        swap.setValue('approval', 'requested');
        swap.setValue('swap_type', swapType);
        swap.justification = p.comments; // Optional Comments Set

        var swapSysId = swap.insert();

        if (swapSysId) {
            var createdSwap = new GlideRecord('x_birl3_clm_nt_limit_swap_request');
            if (createdSwap.get(swapSysId)) {
                // HIGHLIGHT: SET VALUE - Passing Swap Number back to front-end for Step 3 Success screen
                data.swapNumber = createdSwap.getValue('number');
            }
        } else {
            data.serverError = 'Unable to create swap request. System error.';
        }
    }
})();]]></script><servicenow>false</servicenow><sys_class_name>sp_widget</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>shobharani.k@mindsprint.com</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-05-27 05:39:19</sys_created_on><sys_id>de84cdee2bc147104572f3745e91bf4b</sys_id><sys_mod_count>65</sys_mod_count><sys_name>UCLM Limit Swap Request</sys_name><sys_package display_value="CLM" source="x_birl3_clm">d01e8ce22bb27e104572f3745e91bfe3</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="CLM">d01e8ce22bb27e104572f3745e91bfe3</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sp_widget_de84cdee2bc147104572f3745e91bf4b</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>gaurav.gorane@mindsprint.com</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-08 06:29:04</sys_updated_on><template><![CDATA[<div class="abg-widget-container">

  <div ng-if="c.data.isInitialized">

            <label>Donee Site (Your Jurisdiction) <span class="text-danger">*</span></label>

              <div class="abg-select-display" ng-click="c.toggleDoneeDropdown($event)">
                <span class="text-muted" ng-if="!c.selected.doneeSite">-- Select Donee Site --</span>
                <span ng-if="c.selected.doneeSite"><strong>{{c.selected.doneeSiteDisplayCode}}</strong> — {{c.selected.doneeSiteDisplayName}}</span>
                <i class="fa fa-chevron-down pull-right m-t-xs text-muted"></i>
              </div>
              <div class="abg-select-dropdown" ng-show="c.showDoneeDropdown">
                
                <div class="abg-select-option" ng-repeat="site in c.data.allSites"
                     ng-class="{'disabled-option': !site.is_allowed_donee || site.has_ongoing_request, 'selected-option': c.selected.doneeSite === site.sys_id}"
                     ng-click="(site.is_allowed_donee && !site.has_ongoing_request) && c.selectDonee(site)">
                  
                  <div class="clearfix m-b-xs">
                    <strong class="pull-left site-code">{{site.customer_code}}</strong>
                    <span class="pull-left m-l-sm site-name">{{site.name}}</span>
                    <div class="pull-right">
                      <span class="badge badge-warning abg-badge-ongoing" ng-if="site.has_ongoing_request"><i class="fa fa-clock-o"></i> Ongoing Request</span>
                      <span class="badge badge-danger abg-badge-unauth" ng-if="!site.is_allowed_donee && !site.has_ongoing_request">]]>🚫<![CDATA[ Unauthorized</span>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  <div class="text-muted site-meta">

                </div>

              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div class="col-md-4 form-group abg-input-group">

          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div ng-if="c.selected.doneeSite && c.selected.doneeAmount > 0" class="m-t-md p-t-md" style="border-top: 2px dashed #EAEAEA;">

        <div class="alert alert-warning" ng-if="c.hasOnlyInsufficientSites()">
          <span class="glyphicon glyphicon-exclamation-sign"></span> <strong>No valid Donor Sites found:</strong> Other sites under this PAN either do not have enough available credit balance or are locked in an ongoing request.

        <div class="table-responsive">

                <td class="text-center">

                <td>{{::site.region}}</td>
                <td>{{::site.depot}}</td>

            </tbody>

    </div>

    <div ng-if="c.data.currentStep == 2">

            <div class="col-xs-8"><strong>{{c.selected.doneeSiteName}}</strong></div>
          </div>
          <hr class="m-t-sm m-b-sm">
          <div class="row m-b-sm">
            <div class="col-xs-4 text-muted font-weight-bold text-uppercase summary-label">Amount Requested</div>
            <div class="col-xs-8"><strong class="text-danger amount-display">₹ {{c.selected.doneeAmount | number:2}}</strong></div>
          </div>
          <hr class="m-t-sm m-b-sm">
          <div class="row m-b-sm">
            <div class="col-xs-4 text-muted font-weight-bold text-uppercase summary-label">Donor Site (Deducting)</div>
            <div class="col-xs-8"><strong>{{c.selected.donorSiteName}}</strong></div>
          </div>
          <hr class="m-t-sm m-b-sm">
          <div class="row">
            <div class="col-xs-4 text-muted font-weight-bold text-uppercase summary-label">Donor Available Limit</div>
            <div class="col-xs-8"><strong>₹ {{c.selected.donorAvailable | number:2}}</strong></div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="form-group abg-input-group m-t-md">
        <label>Business Rationale / Comments (Optional)</label>
        <textarea class="form-control" rows="3" ng-model="c.selected.comments" placeholder="Provide reason for this limit swap..."></textarea>
      </div>

      <div class="text-right m-t-lg border-top p-t-md">
        <button class="btn btn-default m-r-sm" ng-click="c.data.currentStep = 1" ng-disabled="c.data.isSubmitting">Back</button>

      <div class="m-t-lg">

    </div>
  </div>
